build_habitat_sim_config: build a Habitat-sim Configuration object from a settings dict with scene, physics, and camera sensor specs
create_default_simulator_settings: create a default settings dict for Habitat-sim with 1280x720 resolution and physics enabled
initialize_simulator_from_settings: initialize a Habitat-sim simulator instance with object, asset, stage, and rigid body managers
run_physics_simulation: run physics simulation for a given number of world seconds at 60Hz and collect observations
build_scene_selection_ui: build an IPyWidget dropdown UI to select and load scenes from the metadata mediator
